translations.web: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
translations.bsb: Wisdom is supreme; so acquire wisdom. And whatever you may acquire, gain understanding.
translations.kjv: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
translations.asv: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom; Yea, with all thy getting get understanding.
